implementation_determination.MEM-MESH-ENTRIES: The sole retained CPU cache inserts only after count admission and LRU eviction. Each renderer owns its cache; consumer borrows cannot escape with retained entries. Count/capacity are directly observable. Oversized meshes paint without insertion.
implementation_determination.MEM-MESH-CPU: Keys, ring capacity, mesh boxes, allocator headers and inline cache owner are included. Payload evicts before construction and table growth. Borrowed consume finishes before cache mutation; frame-output copies and transient oversized construction are not retained cache allocations. Those remain governed by their separate accounting/RSS obligations.
implementation_determination.MEM-MESH-GPU: Panel/menu control-bearing streams share the 4 MiB retention allowance and hard 16 MiB screen/512 MiB process budgets. Charging all mixed geometry is conservative. Tracked allocation identity/permits account shared submission references once and preserve retiring/device-replaced capacity. Uncached CTL-02 frames still paint; hard admission errors never silently drop controls.
